name_zh: 郑周永：从战争逃兵到汉江奇迹缔造者的『极限生存创业法』与政商共生治理范式
name_en: Chung Ju-yung: From War Deserter to Han River Miracle Architect — the 'Extreme Survival Entrepreneurship' and Government-Business Symbiosis Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 郑周永（정주영，Chung Ju-yung，1915-2001）是韩国现代集团（Hyundai Group）创始人、朴正熙政权下'汉江奇迹'的核心工业引擎。他出身朝鲜半岛黄海道贫困农民家庭，1939年因被强征为战争劳工后逃回故乡，以50万韩元起家承包战后废墟中的土木建筑工程。郑周永的核心理念是将'极限生存压力'转化为'超常规执行效率'——以'凌晨五点开会、八点开工'的极端工作伦理，在朝鲜战争废墟上完成了大韩民国第一条高速公路（京釜公路）和首座大型水坝（锦江大坝），奠定了韩国重工业基础。他将'政商共生'模式制度化：与朴正熙政权建立深度合作关系，以国家主导的工业化战略换取政府订单和保护，同时通过'现代建设→现代重工业→现代汽车'的纵向产业链整合，完成了韩国从土木工程向钢铁、造船、汽车的产业升级。郑周永是Protreptic中模式34（战略预判法）在'从低端承包到重工业全产业链布局'场景的唯一东亚样本，也是模式12（系统思维）在'政商共生关系制度化'场景的独特代表。
description_en: Chung Ju-yung (정주영, 1915-2001) was founder of Hyundai Group and the core industrial engine of South Korea's 'Miracle on the Han River' under President Park Chung-hee. Born to a poor farming family in黄海道, North Korea, he was forcibly conscripted as war labor in 1939 and escaped back to his hometown, starting with 500,000 won to contract civil engineering projects amid post-war ruins. Chung's core philosophy was transforming 'extreme survival pressure' into 'extraordinary execution efficiency' — with extreme work ethics of '5am meetings, 8am开工', he completed South Korea's first expressway (Gyeongbu Expressway) and largest dam (Geumgang Dam) from Korean War rubble, laying the foundation for heavy industry. He institutionalized 'government-business symbiosis': deep cooperation with Park Chung-hee's regime, trading state-led industrialization strategy for government contracts and protection, while completing Korea's industrial upgrade from civil engineering to steel, shipbuilding, and automobiles through vertical chain integration ('Hyundai Construction → Hyundai Heavy Industries → Hyundai Motor'). Chung is the sole East Asian sample of mode 34 (Strategic Prediction) in 'from low-end contracting to heavy industry full-chain layout' scenarios, and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'institutionalizing government-business symbiosis' scenarios.
reason_zh: 郑周永填补了Protreptic在'东亚政商共生型工业化路径'领域的空白。他以从战争逃兵到工业帝国缔造者的极端人生轨迹，展示了如何在资源极度匮乏条件下通过'极限生存创业法'实现产业跃迁；也是模式34在'从土木工程到重工业全产业链'场景的唯一韩国样本。他的政商共生模式对理解东亚发展型国家（developmental state）的运作机制具有不可替代的研究价值，也为后发国家的产业政策提供了经典案例。
reason_en: Chung Ju-yung fills Protreptic's gap in 'East Asian government-business symbiosis industrialization path'. His extreme life trajectory from war deserter to industrial empire builder demonstrates how to achieve industrial leapfrogging through 'extreme survival entrepreneurship' under extreme resource scarcity; also the sole Korean sample of mode 34 in 'from civil engineering to heavy industry full-chain' scenarios. His government-business symbiosis model is irreplaceable for understanding the operational mechanisms of East Asian developmental states and provides a classic case study for industrial policy in late-developing nations.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式34战略预判法）：危机识别与机遇锁定——在朝鲜战争废墟中，准确判断国家重建需求远大于私人消费，将有限的50万韩元全部投入土木工程承包而非消费品生意
第2步（模式12系统思维）：政商共生架构设计——与朴正熙政权建立深度合作，以'国家主导工业化'换取政府大型工程订单（锦江大坝、京釜高速公路），同时通过利润再投资建立现代钢铁、现代重工业等子公司
第3步（模式20价值链重构）：产业链纵向整合——从单纯的土木工程承包商升级为'建设→钢铁→造船→汽车'的完整工业链条，每一环节为下一环节提供基础支撑
第4步（模式38摸石头过河）：渐进式产业升级——从最低端的土木承包起步，逐步进入重工业、造船业（现代重工1972年成立），最终实现汽车制造，每一步都以前一阶段积累的资本和技术为基础
第5步（范式固化）：汉江奇迹引擎——将'极限生存→政商共生→产业链整合→渐进升级'四环沉淀为韩国工业化路径的可操作模板，成为发展型国家理论的典型样本
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 34 Strategic Prediction): Crisis identification and opportunity lock — amid Korean War rubble, accurately judged that national reconstruction demand far exceeded private consumption needs, investing all 500,000 won in civil engineering contracting rather than consumer goods

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Government-business symbiosis architecture — deep cooperation with Park Chung-hee regime, trading 'state-led industrialization' for government mega-project contracts (Geumgang Dam, Gyeongbu Expressway), while building subsidiary companies in steel and heavy industry through profit reinvestment

Step 3 (Mode 20 Value Chain Restructuring): Vertical chain integration — upgrading from pure civil engineering contractor to complete industrial chain of 'construction→steel→shipbuilding→automobiles', each phase providing foundation for the next

Step 4 (Mode 38 Testing Waters): Gradual industrial upgrading — starting from lowest-end civil contracting, progressively entering heavy industry (Hyundai Heavy Industries 1972), shipbuilding, and finally automobiles, each step built on accumulated capital and technology from prior phases

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Han River miracle engine — condensing 'extreme survival→government-business symbiosis→chain integration→gradual upgrading' into an operable template for Korean industrialization, becoming a classic sample of developmental state theory
expected_zh: 掌握郑周永从战争逃兵到工业帝国缔造者的极端人生轨迹；理解'极限生存创业法'如何在资源匮乏条件下转化为产业跃迁动力；评估政商共生模式对东亚发展型国家理论的贡献。
expected_en: Master Chung Ju-yung's extreme life trajectory from war deserter to industrial empire builder; understand how 'extreme survival entrepreneurship' transforms into industrial leapfrogging under resource scarcity; evaluate the contribution of government-business symbiosis model to East Asian developmental state theory.
case_zh: 1972年现代重工在浦项港开山填海建厂，郑周永亲自指挥工人用铁锹一筐筐搬石填海。当时韩国没有任何造船技术基础，但他以'国家需要'为战略支点，从日本引进技术、雇佣韩国工程师，仅用3年建成亚洲最大造船厂。该厂1975年交付了世界首艘45万吨级超大型原油船（VLCC），标志着韩国造船业跻身世界一流。此后现代重工连续30年全球造船产量第一，成为'汉江奇迹'中最具象征意义的工业图腾。郑周永晚年还曾以无党派候选人身份参加1992年韩国总统选举，获得48.6%的选票，展现了企业领袖向政治领域延伸的独特路径。
case_en: In 1972, Hyundai Heavy Industries built a shipyard by clearing mountains and filling the sea at Pohang Harbor. Chung personally directed workers to carry stones basket-by-basket with shovels. At that time, Korea had no shipbuilding technology foundation whatsoever, but he used 'national need' as his strategic pivot, importing Japanese technology and training Korean engineers, completing Asia's largest shipyard in just 3 years. The yard delivered the world's first 450,000-ton VLCC in 1975, marking Korea's entry into the world's top shipbuilding tier. Hyundai Heavy Industries has ranked #1 in global shipbuilding output for 30 consecutive years, becoming the most symbolic industrial totem of the 'Han River Miracle'. In his later years, Chung also ran for South Korean president as an independent candidate in 1992, receiving 48.6% of the vote — demonstrating a unique path from business leader to political arena.
